inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {ℓ r S : ℕ} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ}
  {μ : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ} {L : ℕ},
  (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ μ x) →
    ∑ x, μ x = 1 →
      (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), μ x ≠ 0 → QuarticQuery.promised f x) →
        (∀ (U : QuarticQuery.QueryTree κ), U.depth ≤ L → QuarticQuery.treeSuccess f μ U ≤ 2 / 3) →
          ∀ (T : QuarticQuery.QueryTree (QuarticQuery.BitLoc ℓ r S κ)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ) (t : ℕ),
            (QuarticQuery.avg (QuarticQuery.prodW (QuarticQuery.prodW μ)) fun A =>
                QuarticQuery.avg (QuarticQuery.prodW (QuarticQuery.unif ℓ)) fun J =>
                  QuarticQuery.Paper.reachedCellAt f L T J A i t) ≤
              (2 / 3) ^ r
